scope: All280 lesson scene images. Preserve canonical faces and distinct five-section coverage. Recheck anatomy, moderate proportions, palette and lesson-grounded screen meaning.

proportions.ownerFeedback: Original heads were oversized. First reduction was explicitly rejected as too small. Use the intermediate stylized adult appearance; no imposed realistic seven-head ratio.
proportions.method: Only correct visibly disproportionate figures. Usually a modest10-15 percent adjustment where needed; exact facial morphology stays unchanged. Re-evaluate full body, head/neck/shoulder connection, pelvis, thigh/knee/foot proportions and furniture spacing.

palette.basis: Canonical room plates, muted sage green, aged brass, charcoal/navy clothing and natural skin. Preserve justified scene lighting.

screens.requirement: Every prominent panel must communicate a specific fact, operation, input, comparison, output or unresolved question from the current lesson and section.
screens.sourceEvidence: Record current MDX and relevant exercise YAML. Verify labels, values, shapes, axes, counts, order, topology and any outcome. Identify illustrative examples and fictional timings.
screens.labels: Short verified labels are allowed when they make the diagram understandable. No fake code or decorative glyphs.
screens.phaseBoundary: Challenges depict pending work and inputs. Do not imply a correct result before the learner completes the task.
